key_decisions: MEASURE BEFORE YOU DESIGN. The Voice Changer hero's device was settled by an envelope-correlation number (0.867 vs a -0.004 control) computed before a single frame existed. For an audio flow whose change is invisible, the measurement IS the art direction.
FABIO'S REVIEW CONVENTION: he names ONLY what he dislikes. Silence means approved.

A PRE-EXISTING FALSE CLAIM IN UNRELEASED COPY IS FIXED, NOT WORKED AROUND. Adding a ninth flow bullet under a sentence that says no flow downloads weights - when Head Swap already did - would have shipped the lie twice. The file's own header points at a copy-review Gate 0 for exactly this. Re-run the same audit when Flow B lands: it will be the THIRD flow with weights of its own.

PLATES FROM A RUN THE USER ALREADY DID ARE FREE, AND THE SIDECAR HANDS YOU EVERY LEG. Media/.meta/<uuid>.json carries generationSettings.mediaItems with one entry per input role, pointing into the content-addressed .preview-assets/. Ask first - they are the user's own material.
constraints: THE REPO'S JETBRAINS MONO IS .woff2, WHICH NEITHER ffmpeg drawtext NOR sharp/librsvg CAN LOAD, and the font is not installed on this box. Type layers are rendered by HEADLESS CHROME off an HTML file with a file:// @font-face, screenshotted at exact size, then composited by ffmpeg. Pass --disable-lcd-text --force-color-profile=srgb or every label ships with subpixel colour fringing.

AN oklch() TOKEN CAN BE CONVERTED IN CODE instead of through the canvas trick, but ONLY if the converter is validated first against the two hexes 06-preview-image already records (FF7EB6, FF7EB6 is out of sRGB gamut, and 48D7FE). A converter that reproduces both is then trustworthy for the surface/ink tokens too.

HEREDOCS AND BACKSLASH-NEWLINE CONTINUATIONS ARE BOTH BLOCKED by guard-shell. Write scripts to the scratchpad and run them by path; git commit -F <file>. Also: Git Bash rewrites a bare /PID into C:/Program Files/Git/PID, so taskkill must go through PowerShell.
